mapper.select: select (select coalesce(sum(case when t.transaction_type = 'INCOME' then t.amount else 0 end), 0) from `transaction` t where t.collection_id = #{collectionId} and t.family_id = #{familyId} and t.deleted_at is null ) as totalIncome, (select coalesce(sum(case when t.transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' then t.amount else 0 end), 0) from `transaction` t where t.collection_id = #{collectionId} and t.family_id = #{familyId} and t.deleted_at is null ) as totalExpense, (select count(*) from `transaction` t where t.collection_id = #{collectionId} and t.family_id = #{familyId} and t.deleted_at is null and t.transaction_type <> 'TRANSFER' ) as transactionCount, (select count(*) from schedule s where s.collection_id = #{collectionId} and s.family_id = #{familyId} and s.deleted_at is null ) as scheduleCount, (select count(*) from diary d where d.collection_id = #{collectionId} and d.family_id = #{familyId} and d.deleted_at is null ) as diaryCount, (select count(*) from photo p where p.family_id = #{familyId} and p.deleted_at is null and p.diary_id in ( select d2.id from diary d2 where d2.collection_id = #{collectionId} and d2.family_id = #{familyId} and d2.deleted_at is null ) ) as photoCount
